'''Lord Percival Amberwood''' is a [[human]] quest giver located in [[Amberwood Keep]] in [[Northwind]]. He is the fourth descendant of the Amberwood lineage and oversees the region as a whole. All citizens of Northwind answer to him and his wise decisions. Beloved by many, his way of ruling follows a more calculated way compared to that of his father.<ref>[[The Nobles of Northwind]]</ref>

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Alliance|28|In Amber Disgust}} {{questfinish}}
* {{questlong|Alliance|32|The Messenger Of Northwind}} {{queststart}}

==Quotes==
===Gossip===
Welcome to Northwind. I apologize for the sorry state you find it in. It seems all of these problems come crashing down on me all at once. And on top of it I don't even have enough soldiers to sufficiently protect my subjects. The populace may think neither I nor my brother care all that much, but that couldn't be further from the truth. And yet, all the strength I have left to solve this chaos is bound by the orders of my king.
